meaning.en: Having good moral conduct and behaving properly.
meaning.zh: 品德好，行为正派。

examples.zh: 他品行端正，深受老师和同学的喜爱。
examples.en: He is of upright character and well liked by teachers and classmates.

examples.zh: 公司招聘时很看重应聘者是否品行端正。
examples.en: The company puts great weight on whether applicants are of good character.

usage.en: Usually a predicate or attributive; common in references, testimonials and school reports.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或定语，常见于评语、推荐信和操行评定。

meaning.en: Having many points that are suspicious or unexplained.
meaning.zh: 可疑的地方很多，难以解释。

examples.zh: 这起案件疑点重重，警方决定重新调查。
examples.en: The case is full of suspicious points, so the police decided to reopen the investigation.

examples.zh: 他的说法疑点重重，很难让人相信。
examples.en: His account is riddled with doubts and hard to believe.

usage.en: Typically a predicate describing a case, account or event; common in news reports.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，形容案件、说法、事件等，常见于新闻报道。

meaning.en: Powerful or famous for a period, though not necessarily for long.
meaning.zh: 在一段时间里权势或名声很大。

equivalents: all the rage for a time
at the height of one's fame for a while

examples.zh: 这家企业曾显赫一时，如今却已销声匿迹。
examples.en: The firm was once at the height of its fame, yet has now vanished without trace.

examples.zh: 他家族当年显赫一时，后来逐渐败落。
examples.en: His family was once powerful, but gradually declined.

usage.en: Usually a predicate or follows 曾; implies the glory did not last.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与“曾”连用，暗含好景不长之意。

meaning.en: To make Confucianism the only officially favoured doctrine, as under Emperor Wu of Han.
meaning.zh: 只推崇儒家学说，排斥其他学派（多指汉武帝时的政策）。

equivalents: elevate Confucianism above all other schools

examples.zh: 汉武帝罢黜百家，独尊儒术。
examples.en: Emperor Wu of Han dismissed the hundred schools and honoured Confucianism alone.

examples.zh: 独尊儒术的政策对后世影响深远。
examples.en: The policy of honouring Confucianism alone had a profound influence on later ages.

usage.en: A set phrase from history textbooks, nearly always paired with 罢黜百家.
usage.zh: 历史教科书中的固定说法，常与“罢黜百家”连用。

meaning.en: Full of dangers and obstacles, one after another.
meaning.zh: 艰险和阻碍接连不断。

examples.zh: 探险队前方险阻重重，但没有人打算退缩。
examples.en: The expedition faced obstacles at every turn, but nobody thought of turning back.

examples.zh: 创业之路险阻重重，需要极大的勇气。
examples.en: The road of starting a business is fraught with hurdles and takes great courage.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; describes a journey, road or undertaking.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或定语，形容道路或事业。

meaning.en: To widen one's way of thinking and look for new approaches.
meaning.zh: 打开眼界，寻找新的思考方向。

equivalents: open up new lines of thought

examples.zh: 多读书、多旅行有助于开拓思路。
examples.en: Reading and travelling more helps to broaden one's thinking.

examples.zh: 这次讨论会为我们开拓思路。
examples.en: The discussion opened up new lines of thought for us.

usage.en: Verb-object phrase; 开拓思路 / 为…开拓思路.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，常说“开拓思路”“为……开拓思路”。

meaning.en: Having a very promising future.
meaning.zh: 将来很有希望，发展得好。

examples.zh: 这位年轻的科学家前途光明。
examples.en: This young scientist has a bright future.

examples.zh: 只要努力，你的前途光明。
examples.en: As long as you work hard, your future will surely be bright.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often used in encouragement.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或定语，常用于勉励。

meaning.en: To value science and rely on scientific methods and reasoning.
meaning.zh: 推崇科学，相信科学。

examples.zh: 学校号召学生崇尚科学，反对迷信。
examples.en: The school urged students to value science and reject superstition.

examples.zh: 一个崇尚科学的社会更容易进步。
examples.en: A society that values science progresses more easily.

usage.en: Verb-object phrase; common in slogans, textbooks and official writing.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，常见于标语、课本和公文。

meaning.en: Free, spirited and unconstrained in style or temperament.
meaning.zh: 不受拘束，热情奔放。

examples.zh: 她的舞蹈风格自由奔放，很有感染力。
examples.en: Her dance style is free-spirited and very infectious.

examples.zh: 这首曲子自由奔放，像一匹脱缰的野马。
examples.en: The piece is untrammelled, like a horse that has slipped its reins.

usage.en: Often describes art, style, character or imagination; predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 常形容艺术风格、性格、想象，作谓语或定语。

meaning.en: Having a handsome or beautiful face.
meaning.zh: 相貌英俊或漂亮。

examples.zh: 故事里的王子容貌俊美，聪明过人。
examples.en: The prince in the story is handsome and exceptionally clever.

examples.zh: 他容貌俊美，却一点也不骄傲。
examples.en: He is very good-looking, yet not at all proud.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; slightly bookish, used for both men and women.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或定语，略带书面色彩，男女皆可用。

meaning.en: To work together as partners.
meaning.zh: 手拉手，共同合作。

examples.zh: 两国决定携手合作，共同应对气候变化。
examples.en: The two countries decided to join forces against climate change.

examples.zh: 我们携手合作，终于按时完成了项目。
examples.en: Working hand in hand, we finally finished the project on time.

usage.en: Usually a predicate; common in news about companies and countries.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常见于有关企业、国家的新闻。

meaning.en: Having a frank, hearty and uninhibited temperament.
meaning.zh: 性情豪爽，不拘小节。

examples.zh: 他性格豪放，喝酒从不推辞。
examples.en: He has a hearty nature and never turns down a drink.

examples.zh: 这位诗人性格豪放，作品也气势恢宏。
examples.en: The poet was bold by temperament, and his works are grand in sweep.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive describing a person's character.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或定语，描写人的性格。

meaning.en: To eliminate a source of disaster completely.
meaning.zh: 彻底消除灾祸的根源。

examples.zh: 治理河道是根除祸患的关键。
examples.en: Dredging the river is the key to rooting out the danger of floods.

examples.zh: 只有根除祸患，地方才能长治久安。
examples.en: Only by rooting out the menace can the region enjoy lasting peace.

usage.en: Verb-object phrase; formal, common in news and policy writing.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，较正式，常见于新闻和政策文章。

meaning.en: Brave and not afraid of danger.
meaning.zh: 勇敢，什么都不怕。

examples.zh: 消防员勇敢无畏，冲进了火海。
examples.en: The firefighters charged into the blaze without fear.

examples.zh: 她勇敢无畏地说出了真相。
examples.en: She fearlessly told the truth.

usage.en: Predicate, attributive or adverbial (…地); used in praise.
usage.zh: 可作谓语、定语或状语（……地），多用于称赞。

meaning.en: To invent a false accusation against someone.
meaning.zh: 凭空编造罪状来陷害人。

examples.zh: 他们捏造罪名，把这位正直的官员关进了大牢。
examples.en: They trumped up a charge and threw the upright official into prison.

examples.zh: 捏造罪名陷害他人是要承担法律责任的。
examples.en: Making up charges to frame others carries legal liability.

usage.en: Verb-object phrase; often with 陷害 or 诬陷.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，常与“陷害”“诬陷”连用。

meaning.en: Having one's career or undertaking go smoothly.
meaning.zh: 工作或事业进展顺利，没有阻碍。

examples.zh: 祝你新年事业顺利，万事如意！
examples.en: Wishing you success in your work and all the best in the new year!

examples.zh: 他近年事业顺利，已经开了两家分店。
examples.en: His business has gone smoothly in recent years, and he has opened two branches.

usage.en: Predicate; also a common wish in greetings and farewells.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，也常用于祝福语。

meaning.en: An atmosphere in which people feel nervous or on edge.
meaning.zh: 场合中的气氛让人感到紧张、不安。

examples.zh: 谈判进入最后阶段，会场气氛紧张。
examples.en: The talks reached their final stage and the atmosphere in the hall was tense.

examples.zh: 考试前教室里气氛紧张，没人说话。
examples.en: Before the exam the classroom was tense and nobody spoke.

usage.en: Often a clause (气氛紧张) or object of 使/让; also 气氛十分紧张.
usage.zh: 常作小句，也可作“使/让”的宾语；可说“气氛十分紧张”。

meaning.en: A road that is steep, high and dangerous.
meaning.zh: 道路陡峭、危险，不好走。

examples.zh: 通往山顶的道路险峻，游客须格外小心。
examples.en: The road to the summit is steep and perilous, so visitors must take special care.

examples.zh: 古时蜀地道路险峻，行路极难。
examples.en: In ancient times the Shu road was perilous and travel was extremely hard.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; for mountain paths and journeys.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或定语，形容山路、行程。

literal: by oneself · set up as · king

meaning.en: To declare oneself ruler without authority, often by force.
meaning.zh: 没有正当名义，自己称王。

examples.zh: 将军趁乱占据一方，自立为王。
examples.en: Taking advantage of the chaos, the general seized a region and proclaimed himself king.

examples.zh: 他在公司里自立为王，谁的话也不听。
examples.en: He set himself up as king at the company and listens to no one.

usage.en: Predicate; literal in history, jocular or critical for a person acting as a law unto himself.
usage.zh: 作谓语；历史上指称王，现也可讽刺人独断专行。

meaning.en: To be held in very high regard by many people.
meaning.zh: 受到很多人的高度尊重和赞扬。

examples.zh: 这位老教授的学问备受推崇。
examples.en: The old professor's scholarship is highly esteemed.

examples.zh: 这本书在业内备受推崇，被誉为经典。
examples.en: The book is highly regarded in the field and hailed as a classic.

usage.en: Predicate, often after a subject like 作品 / 学者; passive in sense.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，意义上是被动；常以作品、学者等为主语。

meaning.en: To establish a secure position that will not easily be shaken.
meaning.zh: 在某地或某领域稳固地立足。

examples.zh: 他刚到新公司，还需要时间站稳脚跟。
examples.en: He has just joined the company and needs time to find his feet.

examples.zh: 这个品牌终于在海外市场站稳脚跟。
examples.en: The brand has at last gained a firm foothold in overseas markets.

usage.en: Verb-object phrase; often with 在……; the 脚跟 may take 了.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，常说“在……站稳脚跟”，可带“了”。

meaning.en: Momentarily unable to find anything to say.
meaning.zh: 一下子说不出话来。

examples.zh: 被记者突然问到这个问题，他一时语塞。
examples.en: Suddenly asked this question by the reporter, he was lost for words.

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，她一时语塞，眼眶红了。
examples.en: On hearing the news she was momentarily speechless, her eyes reddening.

usage.en: Predicate; temporary, with 一时 stressing a brief moment.
usage.zh: 作谓语；“一时”强调短暂的片刻。

meaning.en: Looking down on others and thinking highly of oneself.
meaning.zh: 看不起别人，自以为了不起。

examples.zh: 他取得一点成绩就傲慢自大，不再听别人的意见。
examples.en: With a little success he became arrogant and stopped listening to others.

examples.zh: 傲慢自大的人很难交到真心朋友。
examples.en: Arrogant people find it hard to make true friends.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; a critical description of character.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，批评人的性格。

meaning.en: (Of a ruler or high official) to go out in ordinary clothes so as not to be recognised.
meaning.zh: （帝王或高官）穿普通衣服出门，不让人认出身份。

examples.zh: 皇帝微服出行，想了解百姓的真实生活。
examples.en: The emperor travelled incognito to learn how ordinary people really lived.

examples.zh: 总经理微服出行，暗访各地门店。
examples.en: The managing director went out incognito to inspect shops around the country.

usage.en: Predicate; mostly about rulers in stories and history, or humorously about bosses.
usage.zh: 作谓语；多指故事、历史中的帝王，也可用来戏称领导。

meaning.en: A piece of good news or good luck that one did not expect.
meaning.zh: 没有想到的喜事。

examples.zh: 这份礼物对我来说是个意外之喜。
examples.en: The present was a lovely surprise for me.

examples.zh: 比赛中拿到了第二名，真是意外之喜。
examples.en: Coming second in the contest was an unexpected delight.

usage.en: Usually a noun phrase after 是/成了; also 喜出望外 for the feeling.
usage.zh: 多作名词性成分，常用“是/成了意外之喜”；表情绪可用“喜出望外”。

meaning.en: Dispirited, downcast and without drive.
meaning.zh: 情绪低落，没有干劲。

examples.zh: 失业以后，他整天精神消沉，不愿见人。
examples.en: After losing his job he was downcast all day and did not want to see people.

examples.zh: 别精神消沉，下次一定能考好。
examples.en: Don't be downhearted: you'll do well next time.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often after 变得 / 显得.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，常接在“变得/显得”之后。

meaning.en: Having great importance or lasting significance.
meaning.zh: 作用或影响很大，很重要。

examples.zh: 这项发现对医学研究意义重大。
examples.en: This discovery is of great significance for medical research.

examples.zh: 今天的会议意义重大，请大家准时参加。
examples.en: Today's meeting is very important, so please be on time.

usage.en: Predicate or after 对……; 意义重大 / 意义十分重大; formal, common in news.
usage.zh: 作谓语，常说“对……意义重大”；偏正式，常见于新闻。

literal: on the lenient side · deal with

meaning.en: To deal with an offender leniently.
meaning.zh: 处理违法或犯错的人时从轻发落。

examples.zh: 主动自首的人可以从宽处理。
examples.en: Those who give themselves up voluntarily can be treated leniently.

examples.zh: 考虑到他是初犯，法院决定从宽处理。
examples.en: Since it was his first offence, the court decided to be lenient.

usage.en: Used in legal and official contexts; often paired with 从严处理.
usage.zh: 多用于法律、公文，常与“从严处理”对举。

meaning.en: Lacking sense or consideration for others' feelings.
meaning.zh: 不懂道理，不体谅别人。

examples.zh: 你这样做太不通情理了。
examples.en: What you are doing is quite unreasonable.

examples.zh: 他不通情理，谁劝也没用。
examples.en: He is unreasonable and nobody's advice helps.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; the opposite of 通情达理.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，与“通情达理”相反。

meaning.en: To force a deal on someone against their will, buying or selling.
meaning.zh: 用强迫手段逼人买卖。

examples.zh: 市场管理部门严厉打击强买强卖行为。
examples.en: The market authorities cracked down hard on coercive dealing.

examples.zh: 景区附近有商贩强买强卖，游客投诉不断。
examples.en: Some vendors near the scenic area force sales on tourists, prompting constant complaints.

usage.en: A common news phrase for illegal trading behaviour; often attributive with 行为.
usage.zh: 新闻中常见，指违法的交易行为，常作“行为”的定语。

meaning.en: Not minding the extra work or bother involved.
meaning.zh: 不怕事情繁琐，愿意多费功夫。

examples.zh: 他不嫌麻烦，把资料又核对了一遍。
examples.en: He didn't mind the trouble and checked the documents once more.

examples.zh: 如果你不嫌麻烦，请再帮我看一下。
examples.en: If you don't mind the bother, please take another look for me.

usage.en: Often in polite requests: 如果不嫌麻烦…; can also praise patience.
usage.zh: 常用于客气的请求，如“如果不嫌麻烦……”，也可夸人耐心。

meaning.en: To avoid facing real problems or difficult facts.
meaning.zh: 不愿面对现实中的问题和困难。

equivalents: bury one's head in the sand

examples.zh: 遇到困难不能只想着逃避现实。
examples.en: When trouble comes, you can't just think of running away from reality.

examples.zh: 他靠玩游戏逃避现实。
examples.en: He escapes from reality by playing games.

usage.en: Verb-object phrase; critical, often with 不要 / 只会.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，带批评意味，常与“不要”“只会”连用。

meaning.en: Calm, unhurried and natural in manner.
meaning.zh: 举止镇定自然，不慌张也不拘谨。

examples.zh: 她在台上从容大方，一点也不紧张。
examples.en: She was poised on stage and not at all nervous.

examples.zh: 面试时要表现得从容大方。
examples.en: In an interview you should come across as calm and at ease.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; for manners and bearing. Often after 显得.
usage.zh: 作谓语或状语，形容举止，常接在“显得”后。

meaning.en: Bright and radiant with sunshine.
meaning.zh: 阳光明亮，光彩夺目。

examples.zh: 今天阳光灿烂，我们去公园野餐吧。
examples.en: The sun is brilliant today, so let's have a picnic in the park.

examples.zh: 她脸上总挂着阳光灿烂的笑容。
examples.en: She always wears a sunny smile.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; also used figuratively for a bright smile or mood.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，也可比喻明朗的笑容或心情。

meaning.en: Having a clean moral record, especially free of corruption.
meaning.zh: 品德操行纯正，没有污点。

examples.zh: 这位老干部一生操守清白。
examples.en: The veteran official was of spotless integrity all his life.

examples.zh: 录用公务员要审查其是否操守清白。
examples.en: In hiring civil servants, they check that the candidate's record is clean.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; typically used of officials.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，多指官员。

meaning.en: A family that is comfortably off, neither poor nor rich.
meaning.zh: 生活比较宽裕的家庭。

examples.zh: 他出生在一个小康之家，从小衣食无忧。
examples.en: He was born into a comfortably-off family and never worried about food or clothes.

examples.zh: 这些年，越来越多的家庭成为小康之家。
examples.en: In recent years more and more families have become comfortably off.

usage.en: A noun phrase; often with 出身 / 成为.
usage.zh: 名词性短语，常与“出身”“成为”搭配。

meaning.en: Skilled at adjusting one's approach to suit circumstances.
meaning.zh: 能根据情况灵活处理问题。

examples.zh: 做生意要善于变通，不能死守老办法。
examples.en: In business you must be good at adapting, not cling to old methods.

examples.zh: 他善于变通，总能找到解决问题的新办法。
examples.en: He is adaptable and always finds a new way round a problem.

usage.en: Predicate; 善于 + verb pattern; praise.
usage.zh: 作谓语；“善于”加动词的结构，用于称赞。

meaning.en: Having a bold, high-spirited bearing.
meaning.zh: 精神饱满，气势高昂。

examples.zh: 运动员们气概昂扬地走进赛场。
examples.en: The athletes strode into the arena with confident spirit.

examples.zh: 战士们气概昂扬，士气高涨。
examples.en: The soldiers were high-spirited and morale ran high.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial (…地); fairly literary.
usage.zh: 作谓语或状语（……地），略带书面色彩。

meaning.en: To boast openly and without restraint.
meaning.zh: 毫无顾忌地夸耀、吹牛。

examples.zh: 他到处大肆吹嘘自己的功劳。
examples.en: He goes around loudly bragging about his own achievements.

examples.zh: 广告大肆吹嘘产品的效果，实际并非如此。
examples.en: The advert makes extravagant claims for the product, which are not true.

usage.en: Verb-object phrase; 大肆 pairs with negative acts (大肆挥霍, 大肆宣扬).
usage.zh: 动宾短语；“大肆”多搭配贬义行为，如“大肆挥霍”“大肆宣扬”。

meaning.en: To refuse absolutely to give way or settle for less.
meaning.zh: 绝不让步，不肯退让。

examples.zh: 对于原则问题，我们决不妥协。
examples.en: On matters of principle we will never compromise.

examples.zh: 她决不妥协，坚持要把质量放在第一位。
examples.en: She refused to compromise and insisted that quality come first.

usage.en: Predicate; 决不 is stronger than 不. Compare 绝不.
usage.zh: 作谓语；“决不”语气比“不”重，也写作“绝不”。
